articulation.label: Letter W
articulation.alt: Letter W: /d/ → /ʌ/ → /b/ → /ə/ → /l/ → /j/ → /u/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /d/: Tip touches the ridge; add voice and release.
/b/: Close lips briefly; release into the next vowel.
/ə/: Relax the tongue in the center.
/l/: Tip at the ridge; air passes round the sides.
/j/: Front tongue high; glide into the next vowel.
/u/: High back tongue; round the lips.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: Letter X
articulation.alt: Letter X: /ɛ/ → /k/ → /s/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/k/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; release.
/s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
